label: Reason-responsive control
resolution: SignalSensitive is only one-bit decision input sensitivity. ReviewInfluence/ExternalInfluence are action-changing earlier acquisition interventions with remaining inputs fixed. PresentData is a behavioral projection and can omit that history. None is normative historical ownership, autonomous sourcehood, sufficient free will or responsibility. The deterministic self-review route is not thereby free, and external input dependence alone does not establish real manipulation. The same-past-alternative incompatibilist and historically supplemented compatibilist may both retain their separate standards.
